scripts.coverage-html: npm run mocha && c8 report --reporter=html && serve coverage

scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && pnpm test:types && echo 'tsc ok' && pnpm lint && pnpm format

scripts.test: npm run test-browser && npm run test-node
npm run test-lint && npm run test-system && npm run test-unit && npm run test-integration && npm run test-integration-legacy

scripts.postversion: auto-changelog && git add CHANGELOG.md && git commit --no-edit --amend && git tag -f "v$(node -e "console.log(require('./package.json').version)")"

scripts.version: napi version && conventional-changelog -p angular -i CHANGELOG.md -s && git add CHANGELOG.md

scripts.test: standard && hallmark && (nyc -s node test.js | faucet) && nyc report

scripts.playwright: npx playwright test --config=src/__tests__/playwright/playwright.browserstack.config.ts && npm run playwright:android
scripts.preplaywright: npm run build && rm dist/browser-detection.bundle.js && npx browserify dist/browser-detection.js -o dist/browser-detection.bundle.js --standalone browserDetection
scripts.playwright:ios: npx playwright test --config=src/__tests__/playwright/playwright.browserstack.config.ts --project=ios && npm run postplaywright
scripts.playwright:osx: npx playwright test --config=src/__tests__/playwright/playwright.browserstack.config.ts --project=osx && npm run postplaywright
scripts.playwright:ipad: npx playwright test --config=src/__tests__/playwright/playwright.browserstack.config.ts --project=ipad && npm run postplaywright
scripts.playwright:local: npm run preplaywright && npx playwright test --config=src/__tests__/playwright/playwright.local.ts && npm run postplaywright
scripts.playwright:android: npm run preplaywright && cd src/__tests__/playwright/__tests__/android && browserstack-node-sdk playwright test --config=./playwright.browserstack.config.ts && npm run postplaywright
scripts.playwright:windows: npx playwright test --config=src/__tests__/playwright/playwright.browserstack.config.ts --project=windows && npm run postplaywright
scripts.playwright:local:headed: npm run preplaywright && npx playwright test --config=src/__tests__/playwright/playwright.local.ts --headed && npm run postplaywright

scripts.lint: npm run jscs && npm run jshint

scripts.checkApiSpec: npm run checkManagementApiSpec && npm run checkFunctionLogsApiSpec
scripts.generateApiSpec: npm run generateManagementApiSpec && npm run generateFunctionLogsApiSpec

scripts.build: npm run build:cjs && npm run build:esm
scripts.build:cjs: tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --module commonjs --verbatimModuleSyntax false --moduleResolution node10 --outDir ./dist/cjs && echo >./dist/cjs/package.json '{"type":"commonjs"}'
scripts.conformance:node:promise: connectconformance --mode client --conf conformance/conformance-web-node.yaml -- tsx conformance/client.ts --browser node
scripts.conformance:node:callback: connectconformance --mode client --conf conformance/conformance-web-node.yaml -- tsx conformance/client.ts --browser node --useCallbackClient
scripts.conformance:chrome:promise: connectconformance --mode client --conf conformance/conformance-web.yaml -- tsx conformance/client.ts --browser chrome
scripts.conformance:safari:promise: connectconformance --mode client --conf conformance/conformance-web.yaml -- tsx conformance/client.ts --browser safari
scripts.conformance:chrome:callback: connectconformance --mode client --conf conformance/conformance-web.yaml -- tsx conformance/client.ts --browser chrome --useCallbackClient
scripts.conformance:firefox:promise: connectconformance --mode client --conf conformance/conformance-web.yaml -- tsx conformance/client.ts --browser firefox
scripts.conformance:safari:callback: connectconformance --mode client --conf conformance/conformance-web.yaml -- tsx conformance/client.ts --browser safari --useCallbackClient
scripts.conformance:firefox:callback: connectconformance --mode client --conf conformance/conformance-web.yaml -- tsx conformance/client.ts --browser firefox --useCallbackClient

scripts.build: vp run clean && vp run build:cjs && vp run build:esm && node scripts/write-build-metadata.mjs && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.codegen: yarn codegen:bpe && yarn codegen:chat-enabled && yarn codegen:models

scripts.docs: shx rm -rf docs && typedoc && shx cp .nojekyll docs/
scripts.build: yarn clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json; tsc-esm -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json

scripts.coverage: nyc -n src npm run test && nyc report --reporter=lcov
scripts.release.prepare: npm run lint && npm test && NODE_ENV=production npm run build

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && jest
npm run test-lint && npm run test-system && npm run test-unit && npm run test-integration && npm run test-cli && npm run test-library

scripts.lint: yarn run lint:js && yarn run lint:css

scripts.build: npm run build-vendor-jar && ./gradlew clean assembleServerDebug assembleServerDebugAndroidTest && npm run move-apks && npm run sign-apk
scripts.version: npm run bump-gradle-version && npm run build
scripts.move-apks: rm -rf apks && mkdir -p apks && npm run move-server && npm run move-test
scripts.clean-device: adb uninstall io.appium.uiautomator2.server && adb uninstall io.appium.uiautomator2.server.test

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm-cjs && npm run build:umd
scripts.build-with-test: npm run clean && npm test && tsc && webpack -p

scripts.version: is-prerelease || npm run update-changelog && git add CHANGELOG.md
